name: laravel-forge
title: Laravel Forge
description: View and manage your Laravel Forge-managed servers
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: index
commands.title: Manage Servers
commands.subtitle: Laravel Forge
commands.description: Search and manage your Laravel Forge servers and sites

commands.name: check-deploy-status
commands.title: Forge Deployments
commands.description: Shows sites that are currently being deployed

ai.instructions:
Deployments belong to sites, not servers.
Failed deploy: deployment-status names the failing site, then deployment-log. If nothing is marked failed, take the id from deployment-history.
Site down or erroring: site-online, then site-config for nginx-error-log, then application-log.
Server trouble, like provisioning or a service that will not start: server-events.
Which server, PHP version, repository or branch a site uses: list-sites.
A site's env file is not available here.
Site names are domains and also answer on their aliases. If a lookup returns several names, ask which one.
Only deploy, restart or reboot when asked. Quick deploy being off means Forge will not deploy on push by itself.

tools.name: list-servers
tools.title: List Servers
tools.description: List every Laravel Forge server across the configured accounts, with provider, region, IP address and connection status

tools.name: list-sites
tools.title: List Sites
tools.description: List the sites Laravel Forge manages, across every server or on one named server, with repository, branch and deployment status

tools.name: deployment-status
tools.title: Check Deployment Status
tools.description: Show which Laravel Forge sites are deploying right now and which ones have a failed deployment. Start here to work out which site a question about a failed deploy is about

tools.name: deployment-history
tools.title: Get Deployment History
tools.description: List recent deployments of a Laravel Forge site with their status, commit and timings. Use it to find an earlier failed deployment once the current status is no longer failed

tools.name: deployment-log
tools.title: Read Deployment Log
tools.description: Read the output of a Laravel Forge site's latest deployment, or of a specific deployment, to find out why it failed

tools.name: server-events
tools.title: Get Server Events
tools.description: List recent Laravel Forge events for a server, or read the command output of one event

tools.name: site-online
tools.title: Check If a Site Is Online
tools.description: Check whether a site hosted on Laravel Forge responds over HTTP, reporting the status code and treating a 4xx or 5xx as unhealthy

tools.name: site-config
tools.title: Read Site Config or Logs
tools.description: Read a Laravel Forge site's nginx config, application log, nginx error log or nginx access log

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.title: Deploy a Site
tools.description: Run the deployment script for a Laravel Forge site, deploying the latest commit on its branch

tools.name: restart-service
tools.title: Restart a Service
tools.description: Start, stop or restart php, nginx, mysql or redis on a Laravel Forge server, named directly or by a site running on it

tools.name: reboot-server
tools.title: Reboot a Server
tools.description: Reboot a Laravel Forge server, named directly or by a site running on it, taking every site on it down until it comes back
